description: Read AdSense Management API v2 accounts and reports through MCP.
name: io.github.SirMacke/adsense-mcp

environmentVariables.description: OAuth desktop client ID. Required when not using an access token.
environmentVariables.name: ADSENSE_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth desktop client secret. Required when not using an access token.
environmentVariables.name: ADSENSE_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: OAuth refresh token. Required when not using an access token.
environmentVariables.name: ADSENSE_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Optional AdSense account resource name. The first accessible account is used when omitted.
environmentVariables.name: ADSENSE_ACCOUNT

title: Google AdSense
